messages:
Lina: Quick handoff note — I made a small routing + threshold tweak for tonight's maintenance window. TL;DR: prod token-latency alerts for service=runtime will route to #eng-runtime (escalates Marc -> Jess) instead of #eng-oncall, and p99 threshold bumped during batch window to reduce alert noise. Please ack if you see any side effects.

Marc: ack, thanks. did you update the PD escalation policy or just the route in alertmanager? :thumbsup:

Lina: updated both. PD policy runtime-prod-escalation now has eng-runtime added; alertmanager routing changed for rule high_token_latency_prod. webhook to #eng-runtime added for info.

Jess: can you paste the alert id and the exact prometheus rule? i'll update my runbook and add a note for rollbacks.

Lina: rule id PDR-4721 and prometheus alert below. When in batch window (02:00-06:00 UTC) threshold is relaxed to p99 > 1200ms, otherwise p99 > 800ms. Scope: namespace=prod, job=runtime.

```
- alert: HighTokenLatencyProd
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(runtime_token_latency_bucket{env="prod"}[5m])) by (le, job)) > 0.8
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
    team: runtime
  annotations:
    summary: "High token gen p99 in prod"
    description: "p99 token generation latency exceeded threshold"
  routing:
    pagerduty: PDR-4721
    channel: '#eng-runtime'
```

Marc: nit: expression looks off, you probably want ms not seconds unit. but ok as long as alert matches current metrics. i'll watch from 01:50 UTC.

Tay: will this hit canary or staging? we dont want alerts there.

Lina: no, it's prod-only. prometheus matcher includes env=prod.

Anita: left a note in the runbook about checking kv-cache warmers and the shared model cache if p99 spikes persist. also added a short play: if noise continues after 03:00 UTC, rollback routing and re-evaluate batching config.

Marc: sounds good. i set a reminder to revert at 03:15 if we still see >3 pages in 30m.

PagerBot: automatic notification sent to PD policy runtime-prod-escalation and #eng-runtime channel.

OpsBot: deploybot: config change applied to alertmanager cluster-prod-01 at 1782345600 by lina.

Jess: thanks — acked and noted in my oncall doc. i'll be on-call backup until 06:00 UTC. :eyes:

Lina: awesome — thanks everyone. i'll leave the AD-hoc coverage note in the calendar. if anything unusual, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

Marc: ack.

Anita: ack.

Tay: ack.
